title: Grid DP: ways from above + ways from the left

steps.caption: Unique Paths: you can only move right or down. dp[r][c] = number of ways to reach cell (r, c).
(0,4) is on the top row or left column: only one way to get there. dp = 1.
(1,1): arrive from above (1) or from the left (1). dp = 2.
(1,2): arrive from above (1) or from the left (2). dp = 3.
(1,3): arrive from above (1) or from the left (3). dp = 4.
(1,4): arrive from above (1) or from the left (4). dp = 5.
(2,0) is on the top row or left column: only one way to get there. dp = 1.
(2,1): arrive from above (2) or from the left (1). dp = 3.
(2,2): arrive from above (3) or from the left (3). dp = 6.
(2,3): arrive from above (4) or from the left (6). dp = 10.
(2,4): arrive from above (5) or from the left (10). dp = 15.
15 paths. Fill row by row: O(m·n) time; one row of dp is enough for O(n) space.
